label_rationale: a shared nonReentrant lock covers release(), sweepExcess() and allocate()
mechanism: treasury desk: unallocated revenue is swept to the caller's allocation
arm_reason: a state-changing callback with a user/frozen target; the general assume-guarantee arm applies

closure.justification: functions whose read/write effects intersect the proof footprint ['_status', 'allocated', 'allocation', 'treasury']

ghost_state.name: inFlight
ghost_state.meaning: amount whose treasury decrement is deferred past the call

composition.rule: admissible callbacks preserve I_exp; the post-phase restores I_stable, which implies phi

mcvp_rounds.ag_spec_rendered:
Assume-Guarantee specification for TreasuryDesk_CF04a
  target property phi : treasury >= allocated
  exposure site       : release.call  (low-level call)
  ghost state         : uint256 inFlight

  [A_cb]  ASSUMPTION
          During release's exposed phase, re-entrant control is confined to the
          callback closure ['allocate', 'receiveRevenue', 'sweepExcess', 'release']; every such callback is admitted by the
          protocol, with bounded depth-one nesting.
          discharged by: conservative-closure soundness gate (static, not the LLM)

  [G_pre] GUARANTEE
          {treasury >= allocated && _status == 1} pre-phase {treasury >= allocated + inFlight && _status == 2}
          discharged by: OBL_pre

  [G_exp] GUARANTEE
          forall f in A_cb. {I_exp} f {I_exp}   (I_exp = treasury >= allocated + inFlight && _status == 2)
          discharged by: ['OBL_cb_allocate', 'OBL_cb_receiveRevenue', 'OBL_cb_sweepExcess', 'OBL_cb_release']

  [G_post] GUARANTEE
          {I_exp} post-phase {treasury >= allocated && _status == 1 /\ inFlight==0}
          discharged by: OBL_post

  COMPOSITION THEOREM (instance):
    A_cb => (G_pre /\ G_exp /\ G_post) => treasury >= allocated
      where callbacks are confined to admissible_callbacks=['allocate', 'receiveRevenue', 'sweepExcess', 'release'], depth-one

obligations.purpose: callback allocate preserves I_exp (depth-one) or is excluded by its guard during exposure
obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)

obligations.excluded: guard unsatisfiable during exposure (callback excluded from the admissible set)
